title: tristate_county_incidents
description: Synthetic infrastructure incidents on REAL counties, one row per incident, used to demonstrate a denominator-aware region map on recognizable geography. The 210 counties of Ohio, Pennsylvania and West Virginia are real and keyed by 5-digit FIPS; the incident rows are generated (see gen_tristate_county_incidents.py). No population column is carried on purpose: the rate panel's denominator is FETCHED by --denominator census@2024, not shipped in this file.

county_fips.title: County FIPS
county_fips.description: 5-digit county GEOID. The ONLY geo concept in this dictionary, deliberately: `county` and `state` below are both names that appear in viz's REGION_CODE_LEAVES, so tagging either of them geo.* would create a competing choropleth candidate that scores ~0 coverage against 5-digit GEOIDs and can also perturb --geojson auto's scope resolution.

county.title: County
county.description: TIGER properties.NAME, carried for human auditability of the committed CSV. Its ~200 distinct values exceed CATEGORICAL_MAX_CARDINALITY, so viz skips it as a frequency bar rather than drawing a 210-bar panel.
